purpose: Define the exact resume-first BR204 FULL178 execution surface without starting heavy compute. Operational heavy authorization is exclusively a later semantic arm of the dedicated run-key followed by exact-head manual dispatch.

audited_predecessor.scope: BR204 light preflight plus compact producer/equivalence only; FULL178 heavy excluded

objective_semantics.per_unit_output: exact merged (s,B,capacity) bins for BR202 K8 and BR203 mu; mu bins additionally carry qBC-tail capacity attribution
objective_semantics.global_composition: union exact capacities for all b=0..96 first, then solve one descending exact-rational s/B fractional LP against the retained HPADJ08 envelope
objective_semantics.forbidden: sum or average per-b LP floors; materialize raw 4.1M routing-state JSON; terminal-identity fallback

resume_contract.reuse_rule: accept a carried b unit only after exact worker/base source-lock validation and deterministic parse; compute missing units only
resume_contract.failure_rule: retain already uploaded valid b-unit aggregate streams for one day and resume from them by explicit carry_run_id

storage_contract.bin_stream_note: The earlier 1.83 MiB preflight covered compact certificates, not transient exact bin streams required by the coherent global LP.
storage_contract.high_mass_scaleout_gate: A single b=96 pilot is executed after authorization but before fan-out; it is also reused as durable unit 96.
storage_contract.projection_rule: 97 * measured_pilot_gzip_bytes * 2 + 20 MiB must be <= 500 MiB before fan-out

authorization.later_arm_rule: A distinct post-audit commit must change the run-key from armed=false to armed=true and strictly increase generation. Manual dispatch must target that exact arm commit and the workflow verifies HEAD^..HEAD contains the run-key.

required_checks: global mu LP <= global K8 LP
post_run_gates.br205_gate: Only after the heavy result establishes positive exact qBC-tail objective participation under the same-population global LP and that result is hostile-audited.
post_run_gates.main_credit: requires separate hostile audit and MAIN MIN/replacement consumption; never automatic
